id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_030.pack|cs_: "(gasp)
"Oh, I'm sorry! You gave me a fright. I hadn't expected to see travellers in town.
"Finally! Someone who hasn't been turned into a block of ice! Can you tell us what happened here?
"Well...it began three months ago. It was a bright, sunny day when suddenly a strange shadow filled the sky...it was a witch!
"A witch!? My goodness! That sounds like something from a fairy tale!
"Just so. She chanted an ancient incantation, and the town was engulfed in a ferocious snowstorm!
"The wind took my breath away and I fainted. When I awoke, all was frozen. I was the only one spared...
"She must be a powerful witch to freeze this whole city with one spell. All this ice is more than my magic can melt...
"By the way, missy, that symbol on yer shawl... Is that not...?
"Oh, forgive me! I am Frysabel, Queen of Sniflheim.
"You're the Queen!? So does that mean the auld king is...?
"I'm afraid so... My father passed away last year. I've only been in charge a few months, and just look at my kingdom!
"Sniflheim's in a bit of a sticky situation. I suppose now isn't a good time to ask about the Orb...
"An orb...? What kind of orb?
"The big blue ball that's been handed down in yer family, lassie! Truth be told, we need to borrow it.
"Of course! You'd be welcome to it, but it's locked up tight in the castle...which is locked up tight inside the ice...
"Well, that's just perfect! If we don't melt that ice, we'll never get our hands on the Orb?
"Hmm... Maybe if we got rid of that wicked witch, it might break her spell...
"I thought the same. Only days ago, soldiers from a faraway land came to investigate. I sent them to find the witch and fight her.
"Well, we can't leave them out in the cold! Let's give those soldiers a hand and bring spring back to Sniflheim, shall we?
"What kind of hero are you, playing with the poor girl's feelings like that!? I'll ask again, and answer properly!
"Oh, thank you! The wicked witch dwells in the Hekswood, a haunted forest far to the north of the Snaerfelt steppe.
"Be very wary, for the witch keeps a fierce magical beast to guard against intruders!
"Aye, we'll keep an eye out. Thanks for the warning, lassie. Right, let's head over to the Hekswood!
